notes.title: Apoapsis v1.01
notes.content: The framerate issue going above 60fps seems to be fixed for monitors that are capable of going past 60.

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Although Apoapsis has been out for over a month, it is finally here on Steam!

Just because this game is "done" doesn't mean it won't be improved upon. I have a list of fixes on the storefront page. Feel free to add to the list of fixes.

-For whatever reason, I had to use a frame limiter like RivaTuner to cap my framerate to 60. Not sure why, the game scales with GPU framerate!

-There ARE hidden items, and 2 endings

-Still would love to implement more modes

More later!
